product_overview: A community-driven anime discovery and social platform where users can find and track anime, post and interact in a social feed, join communities and watch parties, message in realtime, and create long-form chronicles and playlists.
core_goals: Discover and explore anime through curated sections and search.
Create, share and interact with social posts in a personal feed.
Join and participate in communities and watch parties with others.
Manage a personal anime list and playlists.
Write and manage serialized chronicles (long-form content).
Communicate in realtime via messaging and live rooms.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allow users to register, sign in, and request password resets to access protected parts of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Fill email and password fields -> Submit signup form -> Navigate to /home
Navigate to /login -> Fill email and password fields -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /feed
Navigate to /reset-password -> Request password reset from reset page -> See confirmation that request was submitted

features.name: Social Feed and Posting
features.description: Authenticated users can browse a social feed, create posts, and interact with other users' posts by liking and commenting.
user_flows: Navigate to /feed -> Open feed and scroll posts -> Observe posts load
Navigate to /feed -> Create a new post from post composer -> Submit new post -> See new post appear in feed
Navigate to /feed -> Like a post -> See like reflected in the post preview
Navigate to /feed -> Comment on a post -> See comment appear under the post
Navigate to /feed -> Filter tabs in feed views -> See filtered posts

features.name: Explore and Anime Discovery
features.description: Browse curated anime sections, search and filter discoverable content, and view search results.
user_flows: Navigate to /explore -> Browse curated anime sections -> See curated sections populated
Navigate to /explore -> Use search or filters -> Submit query -> Navigate to /search -> See search results

features.name: Communities
features.description: Discover available communities, create new communities, and browse community listings.
user_flows: Navigate to /communities -> Browse available communities -> See community list and summaries
Navigate to /communities -> Open create community modal -> Fill community details -> Submit create community form -> See new community appear in browse list

features.name: Realtime Messaging and Watch Party
features.description: Send and receive realtime messages and create or join watch parties with live updates.
user_flows: Navigate to /messages -> Open conversations list -> Open a conversation preview -> Send a message -> See message appear in the conversation preview
Navigate to /watchparty -> Open watch party lobby -> Create or join a watch party room from the lobby -> See participant list and live updates in the lobby

features.name: My List (Personal Anime List)
features.description: Manage a personal list of anime to track what the user is watching or planning to watch.
user_flows: Navigate to /search -> Search for an anime title -> From search results add anime to personal list -> Navigate to /mylist -> See the anime present in my list
Navigate to /mylist -> Open an item in the list -> Update status or remove item -> See list reflect the change

features.name: Chronicles (Long-form Content)
features.description: Create, save and manage serialized long-form chronicles and drafts.
user_flows: Navigate to /chronicles/write -> Start a new chronicle draft -> Save draft -> Navigate to /chronicles -> See draft listed
Navigate to /chronicles/write -> Open an existing draft -> Edit content -> Save changes -> See updated draft in list

features.name: AniJudge (Game Mode)
features.description: Enter the AniJudge home to start or join casual game matches and participate in rounds.
user_flows: Navigate to /anijudge -> Start a new match from AniJudge home -> Join the match lobby -> Participate in match rounds

features.name: Playlists
features.description: Create and manage user playlists of anime or media items.
user_flows: Navigate to /playlists -> Create a new playlist -> Add items to the playlist (via search or selection) -> See new playlist in listing
Navigate to /playlists -> Open a playlist in the listing -> Edit playlist metadata -> Save changes -> See updated playlist in listing

features.name: Settings and Account Management
features.description: Update account and profile settings, including preferences and basic account information.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Update profile information or preferences -> Save changes -> See confirmation that settings were updated

user_interactions: Navigate to protected pages after authentication
